properties/action: Operation: list retained jobs, inspect status, wait for completion, or stop a job and drain its cleanup.
properties/job_id: Managed job ID returned by run_command or action=list; required for status, wait, and stop. Jobs belong to this running process.
properties/timeout: Maximum wait in seconds for action=wait, from 0.1 to 30; defaults to 10. Waiting does not cancel a still-running job.
properties/offset: Zero-based job index for action=list; defaults to 0 and returns every job from that position onward.
